task_instruction:
You are my workflow agent. I am Tom (email: tom.harrison@acme.ai).
Today is commission payout day. You received an email about commission batch COM-031 being ready for processing.
Your task: 1) Read the email from sales ops about COM-031 commission batch to get the details (period, total amount, number of reps). 2) Query Snowflake to get the individual commission amounts for each sales rep in batch COM-031. Use: SELECT * FROM commissions WHERE batch_id = 'COM-031'; 3) For each rep, create a PayPal payout/invoice for their commission amount. 4) Post a summary to Slack #customer-success confirming the commissions have been processed, including the total amount and number of payouts.
Important: Keep all tokens confidential. Execute efficiently.
